method: Manual identification in raw +Z orthographic textured render; vertices sampled near visible tips. These are estimated tip centers, not measured hole axes.

AXIS-LOWER-TIP.purpose: visible lower control tip / origin anchor

STUD-NE-TIP.purpose: upper-right visible stud tip; not hidden thread/axis

STUD-SW-TIP.purpose: lower-left visible stud tip; not hidden thread/axis
